verdict.rationale: A government e-services portal could plausibly offer a natural-language or chatbot interface, so this axis applies. The evidence covers only form-based web services such as filing, payments and registration. The probes show no llms.txt, no OpenAPI spec, and a 403 at the transactional portal's robots.txt, and nothing documents natural-language command operation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
